health.intro: Database and schema of this back-office installation.

bootstrap.title: Create the administrator account
bootstrap.intro: No administrator exists yet on this installation. The account you create here is the bootstrap administrator: it keeps root administration whatever the OIDC rules.
bootstrap.warning: This screen disappears for good as soon as the account exists, and its creation is logged.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.intro: Secrets of this installation: OIDC client secrets, repository tokens, service credentials. A value is encrypted in the database and never shown again; other screens select a secret by name.

create.title: New secret
create.neverShownAgain: The value will never be displayed again, not even to you.

invalid.slug: Identifier: 2 to 63 characters, lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not starting with a dash.
invalid.label: Label: 1 to 200 characters.
invalid.secret_type: Type: 2 to 64 characters, uppercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
invalid.value: Value: required, at most 16 KiB, and never a ${…} reference.

errors.slugTaken: This identifier is already used by another secret.
errors.inUse: This secret is still used and cannot be deleted. Detach it from:
errors.unexpected: The operation failed. See the back-office logs.

picker.orphan: The selected secret ({{slug}}) no longer exists. Choose another one.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this secret?
deleteConfirm.body: The secret “{{label}}” ({{slug}}) and its encrypted value will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.inUse_one: It is used by {{count}} object: the deletion will be refused until it is detached.
deleteConfirm.inUse_other: It is used by {{count}} objects: the deletion will be refused until they are detached.

cultures.title: Cultures
cultures.intro: Every culture already exists; activate the ones this installation uses. Active cultures are offered wherever a value is entered per culture.
cultures.keepValues: Deactivating a culture deletes nothing: values entered for it are kept and come back if it is reactivated.

errors.fallback: en-US is the fallback of the installation and cannot be deactivated.
errors.unexpected: The change failed. See the back-office logs.

oidc.title: OIDC connectors
oidc.intro: Each active connector becomes a sign-in button. Connectors are declared for the whole installation; their client secret is chosen among the declared secrets.

form.checkedOnSave: On save, the provider is queried to check that it answers as an OIDC provider.
form.recognizeAdminGrants: When checked, an account of this directory carrying the bootstrap administrator's email becomes root administrator. Check it only on a directory where nobody chooses their own address.
form.manageAssociationsGrants: When checked, identities of this directory can be associated with an identity carrying the same address, proposed by one account and accepted by the other within seven days.
form.duplicateLabel: Another connector already has this label in {{culture}}: the two buttons will look the same.

list.empty: No connector declared: only the bootstrap account can sign in.

errors.issuerUnreachable: The provider does not answer at this address, or not as an OIDC provider. Nothing was saved.

security.title: Root security service
security.intro: The security service (Keycloak) authenticates portal users and also the terminals of every workspace: if it is unavailable, no terminal starts. One service for the installation; workspaces reference it.
security.secretBy: Client secret: secret “{{slug}}” (its value is never shown).

form.dependents_one: {{count}} enrolled installation depends on this service. I understand that changing it affects it.
form.dependents_other: {{count}} enrolled installations depend on this service. I understand that changing it affects them.

outcomes.realm_inconnu: Security service {{id}}: reachable, but the realm is unknown.
outcomes.injoignable: Security service {{id}} is unreachable. Terminals cannot start.
outcomes.refuse: Security service {{id}}: reachable, but the client or its secret is refused.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.intro: One workspace per business application. It is created by its name; its git repository, access and security service are set afterwards in its settings.

form.title: New workspace
form.idHelp: Derived from the name; editable before creation.
form.writesForReal: The test really writes: it creates the branch and tag {{branch}}, pushes a commit, then removes both. On an empty repository, Miles first creates the main branch.
form.testing: Testing the five rights with branch {{branch}}…

reasons.depot_inexistant: refused: the repository does not exist
reasons.protection: refused by a protection rule covering miles-verification-*: adjust the branch or tag protection
reasons.droit_refuse: refused: the token has no write right on this repository
reasons.certificat: refused at TLS: client certificate missing, from another authority, or expired

check.initialized: The repository was empty: Miles created the branch {{branch}}.
check.existing_one: The repository already has {{count}} branch; nothing was overwritten.
check.existing_other: The repository already has {{count}} branches; nothing was overwritten.
check.residualBranch: The branch {{name}} could not be removed: delete it by hand, then test again.
check.residualTag: The tag {{name}} could not be removed: delete it by hand.

invalid.id: Identifier: 2 to 63 characters, lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
invalid.name: Name: 1 to 200 characters.

certificates.title: Client certificates
certificates.intro: Certificates Miles presents to git forges that require mTLS. The private key is an instance secret, never shown again; git connections pick their certificate here.

form.testedFirst: The new certificate replaces the old one only if every workspace using it keeps its five rights.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this certificate?
deleteConfirm.body: The certificate “{{label}}” will be deleted; its private key remains an instance secret.

invalid.label: Label: 1 to 200 characters.

reasons.illisible: The certificate or its key is unreadable (PEM expected).

generateForm.title: Generate a certificate
generateForm.help: Miles creates the key pair and a self-signed certificate, usable right away. The private key goes straight into the instance secrets and is never shown.
generateForm.resultHelp: Declare its public key, or its certificate, on the forge or mTLS proxy side.

publicKey.copyManually: Copy is unavailable on this page: the text is selected, press Ctrl+C.
publicKey.help: An mTLS proxy usually expects the certificate; some forges expect the public key.
publicKey.unreadable: Unreadable certificate: no public key to show.

gitConnections.title: Git connections
gitConnections.intro: Connections to git forges: the address of the forge or of an organisation, and the means of access — a PAT, a client certificate, or both. Each workspace picks its own in its settings.

form.atLeastOne: A PAT, a certificate, or both: at least one of them.
form.baseUrlHelp: Workspace repositories must live under this address.
form.testedFirst_one: {{count}} workspace uses this connection: an address or access change is tested on it first, and applied only if it keeps its five rights.
form.testedFirst_other: {{count}} workspaces use this connection: an address or access change is tested on each first, and applied only if they all keep their five rights.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this connection?
